title: Nested controlled bases for a conditional 9799/10^10 > 2^-20 bound
body:
This main-based contribution gives the conditional integer-multiplication witness

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad \kappa=\frac{9799}{10^{10}}=9.799\times10^{-7}>2^{-20}.$$

The saving is 2.75% above `2^-20`, 27.28% above #13, and 7.92% above #14. **The final publication check found #15 with a larger stated saving (`1076678/10^12`), so this PR makes no current-best or first-2^-20 claim.** Its distinct nested-basis contribution is submitted for review and potential future combination with the smaller producer in #15. These compare asymptotic exponent savings, not measured runtimes. The result remains conditional on the pinned upstream theorem and written interfaces; it is not formal verification or a linear-time claim.

### Construction

- **Nested common basis at h=32.** Start with Zhihao Chen's ternary five-subset construction (#7), Rohan Arun's fully rebuilt h32 producer/checker (#9/#11/#12), and eumemic's auxiliary source frames (#13). Restrict icekylinx's controlled basis (#10) one level further. The translated auxiliary exit's 32 corner pivots become one contiguous 32-field child, while the existing large corner conditions and both data-corner refinements remain simultaneously valid. An explicit nonzero-polynomial argument covers one rational basis for the entire finite family and both orientations. Exact bit saving: `49/25000000 = 1.96e-6`, moment gap `>3e-10`.
- **All complex residuals at h=28.** Count every actual local physical edge in both orientations and all tensor boundaries. Every nonzero residual is proper, so #10's signed whole-residual identity batches the entire list. Exact complex saving: `4e-6`, moment gap `>1.83e-8`. A new convex dependency-path guard uses total rank at most 22120 and maximum rank 21896, proving rho=3/2 and `C1=3749/2500`.
- **Exact assembly.** All 29 constraints and seven margins are strict. The final absorption gap is `490199500001/(5*10^21)`. The complete manuscript patch keeps historical proofs and redirects the actual transform/resampling/assembly consumers to the new interfaces, with bit arity 32768 and complex arity 21952 explicitly distinguished.

### Validation

- Complete h32 producer rebuilt twice: **23,210,704 additions + 2,014,256 output uses = 25,224,960 auxiliary roles**. Every one of 35,960 star boundaries and all 561 selected templates independently checked with exact support keys.
- **220,673 basis directions per orientation** through the reversible templates, including arbitrary dirty scratch and compiled support-frame paths; all 201,376 neighbor images and 446,400 central Gram entries checked.
- Four joint nested bases exercise **32 complete physical pivot profiles** covering every relevant projector class and its dual; two degenerate-basis negative controls reject as intended. General rational simultaneous existence is proved separately.
- Full h28 complex coefficient, binary-label and physical-role checks; 16 arbitrary-dirty controls at h8/h10; 1,087,080 mixed-sign matrix entries; exact all-edge moment and precision guard.
- **177 unit tests pass**, including five new integration tests. All 19 retained patch checks and the new independent patch check pass. Negative controls reject exaggerated saving, inflated roles, unsupported 2^-19 assembly, duplicate labels, and stale interface references.
- The complete patched manuscript compiles with pdfLaTeX/BibTeX with no undefined or duplicate references. Pinned `upstream/` is unchanged.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3 research/nested-source/producer.py
python3 research/nested-source/verify.py --full
python3 research/nested-source/make_patch.py --materialize build/nested-manuscript
make verify
```

The h32 support rebuild uses several GB of memory. See `research/nested-source/README.md`, `certificate.json`, `producer-certificate.json`, `notes/nested-bit.tex`, `notes/nested-complex.tex`, and `patches/nested-source.patch` for the proof boundary, source hashes and review details.

### Base, attribution and concurrent work

Base is **main** at `6e564879f51ae16f23d392e9e196c605f36d90df`. The branch preserves #13 at `3ef246fa4f69c87ebfed78376418afa9ffcad145` and its #10/#7 dependencies, and includes unchanged attributed research sources from #12 at `35d31e30f28bc5da0ae6a88e7b03d75ebc855534`.

The nested auxiliary-exit basis, full complex residual interface/guard, and h32 >2^-20 composition are contributed by **Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen)**, with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**. The earlier #7 **GPT-6 Astra** assistance attribution is retained as recorded; no runtime-model identity for this continuation is inferred. Follow-up research using these contributions should explicitly acknowledge Zhihao Chen and cite them, alongside the other work it uses. This acknowledgment request adds no license restriction.

Credit to icekylinx for controlled batching and mixed-width interfaces (#10), eumemic for source frames (#13, with Claude assistance), Rohan Arun for dimension/template work (#9/#11/#12), and all earlier contributors and the original OpenAI manuscript. Before publication we also inspected #14 (`1fa5b9a9aaccbebb3eb29ac7ea55811f46464eee`), which independently supplies the same two data-corner refinements at h30. **No exclusive priority is claimed for those overlapping lemmas.** No #14 source files are imported. The final check also found #15 (`a17cab396ce1c79c288bde9d06002cefdc0af8e6`), whose full complex batching overlaps independently with this work and whose stated saving is higher. No exclusive priority is asserted for that overlap; the **nested simultaneous basis** remains the distinguishing contribution. No #15 source files are imported, and combination with its smaller producer is future work. Publication of this verified result before further 2^-19 research was explicitly requested. No worldwide priority, first-threshold, current-best, or optimality claim is made.
